## Section 11.1: `readr`

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
cars_df <- read_csv(here("data/mtcarsex.csv"),
                    skip = 2, ## ignore the first two lines
                    na = c("NA", " ", -999)) ## vector of what should be interpreted as "missing"

read_csv(here("data/mtcarsex.csv"),
         skip = 2, ## ignore the first two lines
         na = c("NA", " ", -999),
         col_types = cols(
           mpg = col_double(),
           cyl = col_factor(),
           disp = col_double(),
           hp = col_double(),
           drat = col_double(),
           wt = col_double(),
           qsec = col_double(),
           vs = col_logical(),
           am = col_double(),
           gear = col_factor(),
           carb = col_double()
         )) |>
  slice(-c(1:2))
cars_df

## Exercise 1
fitness_df <- read_csv(here::here("data/higham_fitness_notclean.csv"),
                       col_types = cols(
                         Date = col_date(format = ""),
                         active_cals = col_double(),
                         flights = col_double(),
                         steps = col_double(),
                         distance = col_double(),
                         month = col_factor(),
                         weekday = col_factor(),
                         dayofyear = col_double(),
                         year = col_double(),
                         stepgoal = col_logical()
                       ))

fitness_df
```

## Class Exercises

Class Exercise 1.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_delim(here("data/birthdays.txt"), delim = " - ",
                 skip = 4,
                 col_names = c("birthday", "name", "species",
                               "time"),
                 na = c("?", "N/A", " ")) |>
  mutate(time = parse_number(time)) ## let's us choose column names
df
```
